headline: Portland Public Schools board to review 2026-27 organizational chart, school readiness, bus lease, and personnel items.
summary: The board will hear a strategic plan update, review the 2026-27 organizational chart and start-of-year readiness, and act on personnel items including teacher and administrator hires. It will also consider a bus lease agreement, the 2026-27 meeting calendar, a Middle School design update, and vote to enter executive session on the superintendent's evaluation and contract negotiations.
items: A Look Back at School Year 2025-2026 and Strategic Plan Update
Review of personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, other hires
Middle School Design Board Update (Harriman MS)
Approve personnel items: Probationary Teacher Candidates
Approve personnel items: One Year Only Teacher Candidates
School Year 2026-27 Board of Public Education Calendar and District Calendar
Enter Executive Session to discuss Superintendent's evaluation

Enter Executive Session to discuss contract negotiations for Portland Administrators' Association, Special Education Coordinators, Multilingual Specialists, Educational Technicians, and Student Enrichment Coordinators
